description: Carosue Dam Picture Database is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by CSIRO Data Access Portal. Supplementary files which accompany CRC LEME Open File Report 217. The Carosue Dam Picture database is available to download in a zip file as BMP files in separate directories. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher CSIRO Data Access Portal. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2025-09-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
